name: Mechanic
overview: Scripture highlights the role of mechanics and artisans as skilled craftsmen appointed by God, exemplified by Tubal-cain, who was an instructor of workers in brass and iron, and Bezaleel, whom the Lord specifically called by name to lead in craftsmanship for the tabernacle. These individuals demonstrate how God gifts and appoints people with wisdom and skill for building and creating, as echoed in the New Testament's call to be wise masterbuilders in our spiritual lives.
